item.title: Skills System——Teaching AI Your "Secret Techniques"
item.description: Deep dive into Claude Code's skills system: built-in vs user-defined skills, how SkillTool works, differences and cooperation with MCP tools. Unveiling how to teach AI your secret techniques, reduce repeated prompts, and improve AI tool reusability.

item.title: MCP Server Integration: Turning Any External Service into an Agent Tool
item.description: Detailed MCP (Model Context Protocol) working principles, and how to connect external services (like databases, APIs) to ADK Go Agents through MCP.

item.title: Your AI Agent Can Think, But It Can't Remember
item.description: AI agents can reason, plan, and converse—but forget everything once the session ends. The Ghost project solves this with a pure PostgreSQL-based infrastructure, turning the database into the agent's memory palace.

item.title: Claude Code Channels: Give Your AI Coding Assistant a Phone Number
item.description: A hands-on look at Claude Code Channels, letting you control your AI coding assistant through Telegram, Discord, and more — no matter where you are.

item.title: Claude Code Re-Explores Your Codebase Every Session? CodeGraph Cuts That Cost by 30%
item.description: Claude Code burns through massive tokens re-exploring your codebase every new session. CodeGraph pre-builds a code knowledge graph that cuts exploration overhead by 30%. Stop paying the 'navigation tax' on repeat.
